title: Gauge project-shape profile v1
description: Declares where a source's jig-style artifacts live (ADR-0009). Config-inline home only in v1 (slice 007-01); a project with no profile normalizes to these same defaults.

goal.description: Optional project goal (ADR-0011, slice 009-01): authored by a human-curated onboarding step (optionally Claude-assisted), never derived from source prose by the zero-dependency runtime, which reads only this literal value. `provenance` names the seeding artifact the author drew from, or 'user' when hand-set/overridden. Additive; a profile with no goal validates exactly as the pre-009-01 identity. Single-sourced (slice 010-01): referenced from both the top-level profile and each entries[] item so the two shapes cannot drift.

provenance.description: Which artifact seeded this value ('product-vision' | 'release' | 'readme'), or 'user' when hand-set.

deadline.description: Optional project deadline (ADR-0011, slice 009-01): authored the same way as goal. `value` is an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the user committed, or the literal 'unknown' when none is set — the machine never infers a deadline from appetite prose. Additive; a profile with no deadline validates exactly as the pre-009-01 identity. Single-sourced (slice 010-01): referenced from both the top-level profile and each entries[] item so the two shapes cannot drift.

value.description: An ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or the literal 'unknown'.

provenance.description: Which artifact seeded this value ('product-vision' | 'release' | 'readme'), or 'user' when hand-set.

artifactRoot.description: Path, relative to the project root, under which specs/decisions live.

specsDir.description: Folder name, relative to artifactRoot, holding spec directories.

decisionsDir.description: Folder name, relative to artifactRoot, holding ADR files.

statusProperty.description: Frontmatter property name carrying jig status (unexercised by the current corpus; ADR-0009 A3).

specLayout.description: Spec-artifact layout under specsDir (ADR-0010, slice 008-01): 'nested' = <dir>/spec.md (the jig preset), 'flat' = <name>.md (one file per spec). 'auto' detects nested-vs-flat by inspection at read time (slice 008-02; mixed/indeterminate resolves toward nested). Additive; a profile with no specLayout is the 007 identity.

appetiteWindow.description: Optional soft appetite-window (ADR-0018 tier 2, slice 013-03): a user-authored ABSOLUTE ISO date curated at onboarding exactly like `deadline` (same shape, same $defs/deadline definition — mechanically identical, since ADR-0018 requires the runtime never parse relative appetite prose, only read a committed absolute date). Unlike `deadline`, over-running this date forecasts to a SOFT amber `over-appetite` read, never a hard red. Additive; a profile with no appetiteWindow validates exactly as the pre-013-03 identity. Single-sourced (mirrors goal/deadline): referenced from both the top-level profile and each entries[] item so the two shapes cannot drift.

entries.description: Optional multi-entry decomposition (ADR-0009 D2, slice 007-02): one repository expands into N portfolio entries, each with its own artifact root. When present, entries define the portfolio entries; the top-level artifactRoot applies only to the no-entries single-entry case.

id.description: Entry id, combined with the project's base id as `<baseId>-<entryId>` (must stay within the project id pattern; enforced at config-normalization time).

label.description: Display label for this entry's portfolio card.

artifactRoot.description: Path, relative to the project root, under which this entry's specs/decisions live.

specsDir.description: Folder name, relative to this entry's artifactRoot, holding spec directories. Defaults to the profile's specsDir, then 'specs'.

decisionsDir.description: Folder name, relative to this entry's artifactRoot, holding ADR files. Defaults to the profile's decisionsDir, then 'decisions'.

statusProperty.description: Frontmatter property name carrying jig status for this entry. Defaults to the profile's statusProperty, then 'status'.

specLayout.description: Spec-artifact layout for this entry (ADR-0010, slice 008-01). Defaults to the profile's specLayout, then 'nested'.

goal.description: Optional per-entry goal (slice 010-01), same shape as the top-level profile's goal. Defaults to the profile's goal, then absent.

deadline.description: Optional per-entry deadline (slice 010-01), same shape as the top-level profile's deadline. Defaults to the profile's deadline, then absent.

appetiteWindow.description: Optional per-entry soft appetite-window (slice 013-03), same shape as the top-level profile's appetiteWindow. Defaults to the profile's appetiteWindow, then absent.

costPaths.description: Optional explicit token-cost attribution for a monorepo TRACK: the repo working-directory paths (absolute, or relative to the config file) whose Claude Code session transcripts — worktrees included — count toward THIS entry's cost. Declaring it overrides the worktree-name heuristic; an empty list `[]` reads $0 (a track never worked on). Lets a track that spans multiple external repos aggregate their cost, and keeps sibling tracks from each inheriting the full umbrella-repo total.
